trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum itself. It pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing extra to do — just work through the rest of this list and it will be the last notification you see.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big grind. Finish the story first, because the in-game 100% checklist only unlocks after the credits. You do not need literally everything — for example only 15 of the 18 collectible card sets count towards 100% — so follow the checklist under Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion and mop up category by category. Expect this to be one of the last two trophies you earn.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable: it unlocks when you finish the final story mission at the end of Chapter 5. After the credits you can keep free-roaming the same save, so nothing has to be cleaned up before this point.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts in total — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — so you need a bit over half of them. Work region by region using Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots, and grab a fast bike or a small plane early; the bridge flights in particular go much faster in a nimble aircraft.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: All 42 challenges sit at just two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers and some only unlock after other conditions are met, so check the map entries if a tier is missing. Learn each target pattern at the lowest tier first, then push for gold — accuracy bonuses matter more than raw speed.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: A strand is a full chain of missions for one stranger, not a single job — you have to see each chain through to its end. Eight completed strands earn the trophy. Pick up every question-mark icon you pass while exploring so chains are already in progress when you start the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: There are 18 card sets scattered across Leonida, but the trophy only needs 3 fully completed sets — pick the smallest sets and finish those first. If you are heading for 100% completion you will pass this automatically, since 15 sets are required there. Cards you have collected can be sold at pawn shops and still count towards the set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK is the scanning app on Jason and Lucia's phones (hold Up to open it). Scannable spots include 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus graffiti tags, and you need 100 successful scans in total. Make a habit of scanning anything the app highlights while you travel; progress is visible under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five separate bank vault robberies, and each one only counts once you have escaped the police response. Bring your partner, park a fast getaway car facing the exit before you go in, and lose the heat through alleys and parking garages rather than long highway chases. Space the jobs out — they are also good money earners early in a playthrough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unlocks automatically at the end of Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the game. If you are reading this before starting, congratulations — this will be your first trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable. Finish the last mission of Chapter 1 and it pops during the chapter transition.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable. Awarded for finishing Chapter 2 of the campaign.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable. Awarded for finishing Chapter 3 of the campaign.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable. Awarded for finishing Chapter 4 of the campaign — a good moment to start tidying up side content before the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable: it unlocks as part of the campaign when you complete the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable: complete The Cartel Heist during the campaign. It is a set-piece mission, so just play it through — no special performance is required.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable: complete the campaign mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable: complete the campaign mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable: complete the campaign mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable: complete the campaign mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: One of the deliberately vague story trophies — its description is a hint about a story moment involving Jason and Lucia's partnership rather than a task. It unlocks on its own as you play the campaign, so do not go hunting for a trigger.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Another vague story trophy, tied to a choice you make during the campaign. It unlocks as part of the story whichever way you decide, so pick the option you prefer and keep playing.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A vague story trophy that unlocks on its own during the campaign — the description refers to a repeated attempt at something in the story. No setup is needed; it will pop as the scene plays out.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A vague story trophy attached to one of the campaign's stranger moments. It unlocks automatically as you play; if you reach the credits without it, check which story beat you skipped, because there is no free-roam trigger for it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish every one of Andy's missions; the trophy pops at the end of his final job. His markers appear as you progress his strand, so if his icon disappears, advance the story or another strand and check the map again later.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's whole strand; his last mission is called Maritime Disputes, and the trophy unlocks when it ends. As the name hints, have a seaworthy boat ready for his later jobs.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand; his final mission is Hometown Heroes. Keep a reliable motorcycle in one of your garages for his jobs — several of them are much easier on two wheels.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand revolves around sourcing specific vehicles from his wish list. Deliver each car he asks for — undamaged deliveries keep the strand moving fastest — and the trophy pops at the end of his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Tyrone's missions, which take you through the Kitty Litter Lab locations around the state. Clear each lab methodically and the trophy unlocks at the end of his final job.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret asks you to track down one specific unique animal. Take the job from him, follow the trail in the marked area, and bring a scoped rifle — the target is a one-off spawn tied to his request, so if you spook it, leave the area and return to reset it.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in the game. You only need to try each one once — no wins required — so knock this out early: whenever a new activity icon appears on your map, play a single round before moving on.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win — not just enter — a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations. Some venues charge an entry fee, so keep some cash on hand. If a course gives you trouble, run it once slowly to learn the gate order, then attack it; drone handling is the same at every venue.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: The key word is different: winning the same race 20 times does nothing. Track the venues you have already won under Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Racing. Most locations let you hire a car, but a personal car with mod-shop upgrades makes the later races noticeably easier.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Head to the area marked on your map and fish there until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a fishing rod — if you do not own one yet, there are usually boats nearby you can borrow.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find any arcade cabinet in Leonida and play its game through to completion — a quick win rather than a high score is all that is needed. One of the fastest trophies on the list once you stumble across a cabinet.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's built-in skill feats, listed under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges. There are 80 in total and you need 50 for the trophy (70 are needed for 100% completion). Sort by your highest percentage progress and finish the nearly-done ones first.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only missable trophy in the game. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and a spot only counts once the full meditation finishes and the final 'zen' animation plays, so do not walk away early. Reports suggest story progress can lock you out of finishing this, so meditate at every spot as soon as you discover it instead of saving them all for the endgame, and keep a manual save before major story beats until it pops. Track your count under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal every region of the map. The fastest way is a long road trip around the state's perimeter followed by the interior — or a plane, once you can fly. Any grey patches left on your map are the regions you still owe a visit.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport, get into an aircraft on the airfield and simply take off without any clearance or flight plan. The trophy pops once you are airborne — expect a wanted level for your trouble, so be ready to leave the area fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhino is the army tank. Steal one — military convoys and the base response to a high wanted level are the reliable sources — and stay in it: the trophy is tied to spending time in the Rhino rather than any single stunt, so keep rolling until it pops, then ditch it before the army ends your ride.

trophies.name: In the Beginning...
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean Beach area and order a cocktail at the beachfront spot with the ocean view. It is a quiet one-minute trophy: walk up, buy the drink, and let the moment play out.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get inside a car inside a vehicle showroom, then drive it straight out through the showroom window instead of the door. Pick a car already parked inside the showroom floor — that is the 'classic style' the description is pointing at.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a game of bowling there, completing your throws with a proper follow-through. Simply finishing the game at this specific alley is what the trophy is tracking.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Take out a target with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by, but with a melee weapon instead of a gun. Line up a slow pass next to a pedestrian target, swing as you pass, and the trophy should pop on a clean hit.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, raise your wanted level to 4 stars, then lose the cops completely while you are still together. Rooftop car parks and alley networks in dense districts break line of sight fastest — keep moving until the stars start flashing, then stay hidden.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Plan a route of three shops close together in one district, rob them in one continuous run with your partner, and never let the wanted level fully drop between hits — if the stars disappear, the chain resets. A fast car and a driver who stays in it between shops makes this far easier.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The clean one: empty a jewelry store without raising any detection — no alarms, no witnesses calling it in. Go in quietly, keep the staff controlled, and be out before anyone outside notices. If detection triggers, reload and rethink your entry rather than trying to salvage the run.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks appear as moving targets around the state. Hit one hard and fast — block it in, deal with the guards, grab the cash — then escape the response. Sticky explosives or a heavy vehicle for the ambush make the opening seconds much safer.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations; you need to rob at least one belonging to each gang, not five of the same one. As you unlock new districts, check whose territory each operation sits in and prioritise gangs you have not hit yet.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows the action, but the window is short — so line the shot up before you trigger it. Find a group of five or more enemies close together (gang operations and ambush missions are ideal), pre-aim at the group, activate Combat Focus and drop all five before it expires.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A vehicle is discovered when you get inside it or scan it. This comes naturally over a full playthrough — speed it up by hopping into every new model you see parked rather than driving past, and check your tally under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your laundering contacts rather than spending them raw, and keep the pipeline running throughout the game instead of grinding it at the end. A quarter of a million sounds steep, but regular heist and vault income gets you there well before 100%.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Cumulative spending at any shops counts — clothes, weapons, vehicle mods, services. It does not have to be one spree; your normal gear and upgrade purchases through the story will carry you most of the way, and a deliberate shopping trip finishes the job.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: There are 8 garages to buy through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, costing $160,000 in total: Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800). Buy the cheap ones as soon as you can afford them — the extra storage feeds straight into On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register vehicles at any Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop — the fee varies with the car's value, and you need a free parking spot in a garage for each one. Register 10 different vehicles; buying garages (Little Boxes) first gives you the slots to do this in one sweep.
